notes.title: Update to ver 1.1.0 on August 3, 2024
notes.notes:
Hunter
　New Hunter "Slash" added!
　Slash excels in high attack performance with rapid multi-hit combos and high mobility.
　However, Slash is an attack-focused character with only one high blow away power attack (dodge attack) and slow stamina recovery, making frequent dodging difficult and leaving defenses weak.

　Fighter
　　Increased sword damage.
　　Increased blow away power of kicks.

　Knight
　　Decreased damage of normal attacks (swings).
　　Increased damage of normal attacks (thrusts).
　　Increased damage of dodge attacks and spear retrieval attacks.

　Archer
　　Increased damage of charge shot.

Enemies
　Fixed a bug where the attack range display of the Demon's reflective attack was incorrect in Boss Rush mode.

notes.title: Full release! ver1.0.0 Major Update!
notes.notes:
New system "Weapon Customize" added!
　Weapon customization items drop when a certain number of enemies are defeated in a stage.
　Weapon customization is available by touching the item.
　There are multiple customization items, some of which change the play feel of the game.
　It's fun to think about what kind of customization is best suited to your fighting style, hunter, skills, etc.

New stages added!
　One new stage added to Hunt mode and one added to Boss Rush mode

Improved visuals!

Added direction!
　-Added special effects when blow away enemies with high-powered manual attacks.
　-Added a special effect when you dodge an enemy's attack with an dodge action.

Change of name
　Knockdown damage -> Impact
　Knockdown gauge→Stability

Enemy
　Changed to disappear as soon as HP reaches 0 before knockdown
　Changed disappearance direction
　Added specification that players' HP recovers by 20% when the boss is defeated
　Shortened the attack interval of bosses
　Strengthened some bosses
　Added ballistic display to projectiles that can be bounced back by manual attacks and some skills

Collision damage was adjusted upward.

Manual Attack
　Added a critical hit system that increases damage and blowing up power with a probability of -Added a critical hit system that increases damage and blowing up power with a probability of
　Increased grace for consecutive attacks
　Changed so that the impact does not change with the strength of the attack. This improves the usefulness of attacks that were quick but weak.

Skill
　Adjusted many skills.
　Removed "Manual Attack Boost" due to the implementation of the weapon customization system.
　Changed the activation condition of "Chakram" to manual attack hit
　Tracker Bullet activation condition changed to manual hit
　Piercing Shot activation condition changed to the moment a manual attack is made.
　Lightning Spear activation condition changed to the moment of a strong attack
　Grand Cross" activation condition changed to the moment of a strong attack.
　Iron Fist Ball" at higher levels, now fires multiple iron fists in a fan-like pattern in succession in the same direction.
　Blast Knockdown" now explodes enemies knocked down by manual attacks or by this skill, and the cooldown time has been removed and it is now chained.
　Blast Wind" now increases evasive movement speed
　Increased the maximum level of "Summon Phantom" to 7, and adjusted the amount of effect when leveling up.

Hunter
　Increased the movement speed of all hunters
　Knight - Greatly enhanced the power of Knight's dodge attack.

UI
　Hunter HP gauge now shakes when hunters take damage
　Added HP and stability UI for non-boss enemies
　Damage that exceeds the enemy's remaining HP is now corrected to the same value as the enemy's remaining HP, but only the damage popup now shows the value before correction
　Archer's charge gauge is now highlighted when it is at maximum.

Option window
　Added on/off for non-boss enemy HP & stability UI
　Added on/off effect when blow away enemies with powerful manual attacks
　Added a setting to switch between rich or simple post-effects in stages
　Added help for enemy gauges
　Added UI to see how to control the hunter you are using when you open a window in a stage

notes.title: Ver 0.5.0 Major Update !
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43809750/9d2452ef7611cc0a58beaa0f17b0d39765e0951f.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43809750/ea4204dd8339a869c560e7d7d12775d1f2da2c86.png

New mode "Boss Rush" is added!
Defeat 5 bosses escaping from the prison to complete the stage!

New character "Archer" added!
Character with excellent single target firepower and range!
Able to attack a wide area by accumulating charges

Skills
New skill "Iron Fist Ball" added!
Skill that calls a sphere that shoots out a huge iron fist when hit by Manual Attack!
The iron fist can blow away enemies that are knocked down
This skill is unlocked by completing achievements

New skill "Freeze Chain" added!
When you blow away an enemy with Manual Attack, it will now freeze for a few seconds before blowing away!
Blow away power inflicted on frozen enemies will accumulate
This skill is unlocked by completing achievements

New skill "Blast Knock Down" added!
Enemies knocked down by Manual Attacks will explode!
This skill is unlocked by completing achievements

Adjusted the "Katon Donut" as it was difficult to utilize it effectively
It now targets the furthest enemy within range and attacks,
Continuity rather than damage is now easier to increase with level up

Base size of "Brutal Swing" has been adjusted up and size increase with level up has been adjusted down

"Rapid Fire" damage has been adjusted downward

"Burst Energy Ball" bullet range has been adjusted downward from infinite to 20 meters

"Magic Card" damage lowered

"Dynamic Bullet" duration and damage lowered

Fixed a bug that caused enemies connected by the "Magic Rubber" to disappear when they were more than a certain distance away

Implemented Steam achievements!

Other
Modified so that the mark left on the ground when blowing away an enemy slowly disappears

Partial adjustment of the graphic representation of playable characters
